principles.name: principle-boundary-discipline
principles.decision: Preserve true CLI, filesystem, data, and external-system seams; remove internal validation or adapters only after callers and tests prove them redundant.
principles.evidence: The requested cleanup spans tools, data artifacts, workflow hooks, and trading code with distinct system seams.

principles.name: principle-encode-lessons-in-structure
principles.decision: Replace repeated operational prose with discoverable config, generated indexes, or checks; retain judgment-heavy decisions in one durable source.
principles.evidence: START_HERE.md repeats commands and workflow policy that also exist in scripts, hooks, and AGENTS.md.

principles.name: principle-exhaust-the-design-space
principles.decision: Compare at least three target repository shapes before selecting the phased migration.
principles.evidence: The whole-repository restructure has no single obvious file layout and plan-flow requires alternatives.

principles.name: principle-experience-first
principles.decision: Optimize the entry path for the next agent and maintainer so START_HERE.md answers where to begin without caching discoverable facts.
principles.evidence: The user explicitly named START_HERE.md as the universal entry point.

principles.name: principle-foundational-thinking
principles.decision: Define the file-liveness classification and target information hierarchy before planning moves or deletions.
principles.evidence: Lossless cleanup depends on distinguishing authoritative, generated, reproducible, historical, and dead material.

principles.name: principle-guard-the-context-window
principles.decision: Partition exploration by code, documentation, and data or operations, and retain only file pointers and findings in the main thread.
principles.evidence: The repository has enough files and long documents to overwhelm one undifferentiated scan.

principles.name: principle-laziness-protocol
principles.decision: Prefer deletion, consolidation, and flatter ownership over new layers or replacement documentation.
principles.evidence: The user's desired end state is an extremely lean repository with no functionality loss.

principles.name: principle-make-operations-idempotent
principles.decision: Require the eventual inventory, move, archive, and delete operations to be dry-runnable and safe after partial completion.
principles.evidence: A whole-repository cleanup can be interrupted and must converge without duplicating or losing files.

principles.name: principle-migrate-callers-then-delete-legacy-apis
principles.decision: Move imports, command references, documentation pointers, and tests in the same phase that removes each old path.
principles.evidence: The user wants the old code gone, and internal callers do not justify compatibility layers.

principles.name: principle-minimize-reader-load
principles.decision: Measure cleanup candidates by layers to trace and hidden state to remember, then collapse one-caller wrappers and duplicate knowledge.
principles.evidence: START_HERE.md currently asks a newcomer to cross several documents and retain historical state before acting.

principles.name: principle-model-the-domain
principles.decision: Represent the audit as a file-liveness registry with ownership, authority, reproducibility, consumers, replacement, and disposition fields.
principles.evidence: Scattered keep or delete judgments would otherwise repeat shape assumptions across hundreds of files.

principles.name: principle-never-block-on-the-human
principles.decision: Infer reversible planning choices from repository evidence and surface any real product decision in the completed plan instead of pausing the audit.
principles.evidence: The user supplied the target, exclusions, and lossless constraint; the remaining work is observable.

principles.name: principle-outcome-oriented-execution
principles.decision: Plan explicit verification points that converge on the target tree without permanent redirect files or dual documentation systems.
principles.evidence: The requested end state is one clear entry path and a lean tree, not a long compatibility period.

principles.name: principle-prove-it-works
principles.decision: Every proposed deletion class needs direct proof from imports, invocations, tests, artifacts, or reproducibility before removal; the final tree needs full checks and smoke runs.
principles.evidence: The user made losslessness the acceptance condition.

principles.name: principle-redesign-from-first-principles
principles.decision: Design the target repository as if START_HERE.md, durable memory, and the live trading workflow had been foundational, then migrate toward it in checked phases.
principles.evidence: The user requested an entire repository restructure rather than local tidying.

principles.name: principle-sequence-verifiable-units
principles.decision: Split the cleanup into inventory, retirement, code consolidation, layout migration, documentation compression, and final proof units, each ending in checks.
principles.evidence: A repository-wide migration cannot be verified honestly as one batch.

principles.name: principle-subtract-before-you-add
principles.decision: Retire dead and reproducible material before introducing the final directory structure or rewriting the remaining documentation.
principles.evidence: The user asked to remove useless code and files before polishing the surviving tree.

principle_exclusions.name: principle-build-the-lever
principle_exclusions.reason: The plan will specify a cleanup manifest and verifier, but building those implementation artifacts now would violate plan-flow.

principle_exclusions.name: principle-fix-root-causes
principle_exclusions.reason: No defect is being debugged; obsolete-file judgments will use dependency and history evidence instead.

principle_exclusions.name: principle-separate-before-serializing-shared-state
principle_exclusions.reason: Explorers are read-only and the implementation plan will sequence repository writes; no concurrent mutable target is required.

principle_exclusions.name: principle-type-system-discipline
principle_exclusions.reason: The planning route defines no production signatures or typed data model; implementation phases will apply this when consolidating typed code.

foundation_assessments.name: codebase-design
foundation_assessments.reason: Use deep-module vocabulary and the deletion test as the foundation for all restructuring candidates.

foundation_assessments.name: diagnosing-bugs
foundation_assessments.reason: Repository cleanup planning is not a bug diagnosis.

foundation_assessments.name: domain-modeling
foundation_assessments.reason: Existing glossary terms will be consumed; plan-flow will not create or edit domain glossary or ADR files.

skill_selections.name: domain-modeling
skill_selections.trigger: Define lossless, authority, liveness, current state, chronology, recovery, and protected scope precisely before the self-grilling decisions enter the plan.
skill_selections.decision: Define lossless, authority, liveness, current state, chronology, recovery, and protected scope precisely before the self-grilling decisions enter the plan.
skill_selections.evidence: The user authorized the grilling session, and the cleanup depends on stable meanings for the file-liveness registry and the three-document authority lifecycle.

skill_selections.name: how
skill_selections.trigger: Trace entry points, runtime flows, ownership, and dependencies before judging code or files obsolete.
skill_selections.decision: Trace entry points, runtime flows, ownership, and dependencies before judging code or files obsolete.
skill_selections.evidence: .agents/skills/how/SKILL.md and the user's request to understand the codebase before restructuring it

skill_selections.name: codebase-design
skill_selections.trigger: Judge modules by depth, locality, seam placement, test surface, and the deletion test while producing cleanup candidates.
skill_selections.decision: Judge modules by depth, locality, seam placement, test surface, and the deletion test while producing cleanup candidates.

method_exclusions.name: diagnosing-bugs
method_exclusions.reason: The task is a forward-looking repository audit and plan, not a reported failure or performance regression.

method_exclusions.name: why
method_exclusions.reason: The task needs current liveness and dependency evidence, not a sourced reconstruction of one past design decision.

method_exclusions.name: architect
method_exclusions.reason: Plan-flow stops before code crosses function or module interfaces; codebase-design owns the current structural analysis.

method_exclusions.name: arena
method_exclusions.reason: No competing implementation artifacts will be built during this read-only planning route.

method_exclusions.name: tdd
method_exclusions.reason: No production behavior is implemented in plan-flow.

method_exclusions.name: pocock-tdd
method_exclusions.reason: The deliverable is a plan; each implementation phase will name behavior-level verification without running a TDD loop now.

method_exclusions.name: implement
method_exclusions.reason: The selected plan-flow route explicitly stops before implementation.

method_exclusions.name: code-review
method_exclusions.reason: There is no production diff to review; the planning gates inspect the plan artifact instead.
